Assign an L1 regularization penalty factor (LLM-Lasso protocol) to each supplied baseline measurement using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Use an integer from 1 to 5: 1 = highly predictive (minimal penalty), 2 = moderately predictive, 3 = uncertain/weak, 4 = unlikely useful, 5 = irrelevant (maximum penalty). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "penalties" mapping every supplied field ID to its integer penalty in {1,2,3,4,5}.
{"task": "Estimate death within one year following lung cancer resection from presurgical observations.", "fields": {"F12": {"description": "PAD - peripheral arterial diseases (T,F)", "name": "PRE25"}, "F8": {"description": "Weakness before surgery (T,F)", "name": "PRE11"}, "F1": {"description": "Forced vital capacity - FVC (numeric)", "name": "PRE4"}, "F11": {"description": "MI up to 6 months (T,F)", "name": "PRE19"}, "F5": {"description": "Haemoptysis before surgery (T,F)", "name": "PRE8"}, "F0": {"description": "Diagnosis - specific combination of ICD-10 codes for primary and secondary as well multiple tumours if any", "name": "DGN"}, "F14": {"description": "Asthma (T,F)", "name": "PRE32"}, "F6": {"description": "Dyspnoea before surgery (T,F)", "name": "PRE9"}, "F3": {"description": "Performance status - Zubrod scale (PRZ2,PRZ1,PRZ0)", "name": "PRE6"}, "F13": {"description": "Smoking (T,F)", "name": "PRE30"}, "F2": {"description": "Volume that has been exhaled at the end of the first second of forced expiration - FEV1 (numeric)", "name": "PRE5"}, "F4": {"description": "Pain before surgery (T,F)", "name": "PRE7"}, "F15": {"description": "Age at surgery (numeric)", "name": "AGE"}, "F9": {"description": "T in clinical TNM - size of the original tumour, from OC11 (smallest) to OC14 (largest) (OC11,OC14,OC12,OC13)", "name": "PRE14"}, "F7": {"description": "Cough before surgery (T,F)", "name": "PRE10"}, "F10": {"description": "Type 2 DM - diabetes mellitus (T,F)", "name": "PRE17"}}}
